PFFFT, a Pretty Fast FFT: version 1.3.1 of the maintained fork
https://github.com/marton78/pffft (tag v1.3.1, commit
fbe9c2b96530ce274f12e008336a8202e15b859b), compiled into Convolver as its
FFT. The sources compiled carry the notices below.
